apps.name: qBittorrent
apps.desc: BT/磁力下载。安装时设 WebUI 固定密码与默认保存路径，装完即用，无临时密码环节

params.name: QB_SAVE_PATH
params.label: 默认保存路径（容器内路径，用户库根=/media，如 /media/番剧、/media/downloads）

apps.postShell: SP='{{ENV:QB_SAVE_PATH}}'; case "$SP" in /media/*) : ;; *) echo "⚠ 保存路径 $SP 不在 /media 用户库树内(影音库看不见)，改用 /media/番剧"; SP=/media/番剧 ;; esac; sleep 3; TMP=$( {{DOCKER}} logs qbittorrent 2>&1 | grep -i 'temporary password' | tail -1 | awk '{print $NF}' ); J=/tmp/.qbcj-$$; curl -s --max-time 10 -c $J -X POST --data-urlencode 'username=admin' --data-urlencode "password=$TMP" http://127.0.0.1:8200/api/v2/auth/login >/dev/null && curl -s --max-time 10 -b $J -X POST --data-urlencode 'json={"webui_password":"{{ENV:QB_PASSWORD}}","webui_password_save":true}' http://127.0.0.1:8200/api/v2/app/setPreferences && curl -s --max-time 10 -b $J -X POST --data-urlencode 'json={"save_path":"$SP"}' http://127.0.0.1:8200/api/v2/app/setPreferences >/dev/null; curl -s --max-time 10 -b $J http://127.0.0.1:8200/api/v2/app/defaultSavePath; rm -f $J; echo ' ← WebUI 密码与保存路径已按安装参数设置'

apps.name: Cloudflare Tunnel
apps.desc: 免公网IP免端口映射，把 NAS 服务经 Cloudflare 定点暴露（Zero Trust 远程托管隧道）。装前在 CF 后台建 Tunnel 复制 token

params.name: CF_TUNNEL_TOKEN
params.label: Tunnel Token（CF Zero Trust → Networks → Tunnels 复制）

apps.postShell: echo '隧道就绪后在 CF Zero Trust 配 Public Hostname 指向 NAS 服务；metrics: http://{{NAS_IP}}:20240'

apps.name: Homebridge (+miot)
apps.desc: 已下架。米家→HomeKit 桥接方案已被 Home Assistant(自带米家集成)取代；曾装过且残留容器的仍可在此卸载清理
apps.postShell: {{DOCKER}} exec homebridge npm --prefix /var/lib/homebridge install homebridge-miot && {{DOCKER}} restart homebridge && echo 'homebridge-miot 已装好，去 UI(:8581) 配插件即可'

apps.name: Home Assistant
apps.desc: β 未在 MINAS 实测。智能家居中枢：一体自带米家集成(xiaomi-miot)，可再经 HomeKit Bridge 桥给苹果家庭。host 网络 :8123，数据库放 pool 盘护 eMMC。登录配置建议电脑浏览器
apps.postShell:
{{DOCKER}} exec homeassistant sh -c 'mkdir -p /config/custom_components && [ -f /config/custom_components/xiaomi_miot/__init__.py ] || { curl -fsSL -o /tmp/miot.tgz https://codeload.github.com/al-one/hass-xiaomi-miot/tar.gz/refs/heads/master && tar -xzf /tmp/miot.tgz -C /tmp && cp -r /tmp/hass-xiaomi-miot-master/custom_components/xiaomi_miot /config/custom_components/ && rm -rf /tmp/miot.tgz /tmp/hass-xiaomi-miot-master; }; python -m pip install -q -i https://mirrors.aliyun.com/pypi/simple/ miot; python3 -c "import json;p='/config/.storage/http';d=json.load(open(p));s=d['data']['stable'];s['use_x_forwarded_for']=True;s['trusted_proxies']=['127.0.0.1/32'];json.dump(d,open(p,'w'),indent=2)" 2>/dev/null || true'; grep -q db_url /data/apps/homeassistant/config/configuration.yaml 2>/dev/null || printf '
recorder:
  db_url: sqlite:////db/hass_v2.db
' >> /data/apps/homeassistant/config/configuration.yaml; {{DOCKER}} restart homeassistant
